landing.title: Kawaii — Multi-tenant item tracker
landing.description: Track savings and income. Create or join a workspace with a code.
landing.heading: Track savings and income across workstreams.
landing.sub: Create a workspace, share an 8-character join code, and manage savings and income together to reach your financial targets

onboarding.heading: Get started
onboarding.sub: Create a new workspace, or join one with an 8-character code.

workspace.joinCodeTitle: Share this code so teammates can join the workspace. Click to copy.
workspace.inviteTitle: Invite a user to this workspace
workspace.inviteBody: Share this join code with the person you want to invite. They can sign up and enter the code on the onboarding page to join.
workspace.onlyAdmins: Only admins can invite new users.
workspace.selectOrCreate: Select a savings or income entry, or create a new one.
workspace.chartEmpty: Add monthly entries to see the chart.
workspace.confirmDeleteFolder: Delete this folder? Items will become uncategorized.
workspace.folderVisibilityBody: Restrict who can see this folder and the items inside it. Admins always have access. Subfolders inherit unless they have their own restriction.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.linkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

members.title: Users
members.lastAdmin: A workspace must have at least one admin.
members.peerAdmin: You cannot change another admin's role.
members.addDirectBody: If the user already has an account, they're added directly. Otherwise, an invite email is sent.
members.alreadyMember: User is already a member of this workspace.
members.freeLimitReached: Free user limit (4) reached. Upgrade to a paid plan to add more users.
members.otherUsersBody: All users across other workspaces. As superuser you can change their workspace roles, remove them from workspaces, and grant or revoke superuser.
members.cannotRevokeLast: You are the last superuser — grant the role to someone else first.
members.confirmSelfRevoke: Revoke your own superuser role? You will lose superuser access.
members.deleteUserConfirmBody: {{name}} will be removed from authentication, all workspaces, and their data will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
members.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account here.
